answer: Edge-disjoint path certification resists sybils: an identity gains trust only if max-flow finds k edge-disjoint paths from the honest seed core to it. The few attack edges a farm buys form one narrow river crossing to the fakes, and flow across that cut is capped at the attack-edge count — however dense the sybil region is internally. A marble-solid block of mutual vouches still bottlenecks there, so flow to any fake stays below k and it earns nothing. An honest agent on the ivory core clears k independent paths easily; a swarm cannot forge edge-disjoint routes without real endorsements.
